text: Skip to main content The IRS2Go app English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Document Upload Tool Report fraud Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages Check your refund with the mobile app No sign-in needed. Just enter your Social Security number or ITIN, filing status, and the exact refund amount shown on your tax return. Download the official mobile app of the IRS. Get your refund status and useful tax information anytime and anywhere you're connected. Available in English or Spanish on Google Play and the Apple App Store. Also available Payments Find all payment options. Pay directly from your bank account for free. Use a credit card, debit card or digital wallet like PayPal or Venmo for a fee. Or sign in to your IRS account to pay, create a payment plan or check your payment history. File for free Access free tax filing options if you qualify. File online with IRS Free File or use Free File Fillable Forms. Get free tax preparation at a local Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) site or with AARP Foundation Tax Aide. Volunteers are IRS-certified. In person and online options available. Do more with an IRS account Do more with an IRS account. Check your refund, access your tax records, pay or create a payment plan, opt in to refund status email notifications and more. Link from the app to sign in or create an account. More resources Link to popular topics on IRS.gov, like refunds, tax records, forms and publications. Contact us online, by phone or in person. Connect with us through X, YouTube and email.
